candidate_change: The display library (libpong-display-v246, backboardd only) answers the panel's size (1440x3200) for -[CADisplay bounds] when the display reports {1206, 2622} and its native bounds are the panel's or empty.  v245 kept the size because the display of the render server has no size of its own when its window server starts (native bounds 0x0, no current mode). Boot argument pong_ca_native=0 leaves it at watching.  Not run on the phone before this image.

The log capture library v246 keeps the last lines of PosterBoard too and passes them on with the signal, the registers and the frames when it dies; lines with an indicator word are passed on at once; in every crash process the fatal signal handlers are armed again two seconds after the start and at the first line, after the other injected libraries.

The Wi-Fi station joins once more as a plain 802.11g station (no HT, no WMM, no extended capabilities) when an access point refuses its request with high-throughput capabilities; both refusals are logged with their frames.
Every library the injected libraries load is compared with the names Apple's own binaries use.

Carried unchanged from v245: the signed UI adapter in PosterBoard, the station's own address and complete request, the Wi-Fi daemon's library and the probe, the Settings diagnostic, the console capture, the firmware LUN check (v243), the retries and the record of a failed check (v242), the interface-namer marker and the en0 listing in configd, the panic record slot (v238), protection classes A and B and IOSurface selector 21 (v237), the v236 GPU timing hook, the v235 witness.  No boot argument changed.
